preflight_attempts.error: No preflight failure occurred; this entry was emitted by the prior audit() code when training files changed.

preflight.original_fusion_path_unchanged: No model/module/parameter modifications; read-only hooks capture both native GTUNet outputs.
limitations: The historical population graph is transductive and includes heldout nodes as in the original protocol.

analysis_execution_deviation: The frozen analyze.py stores paired means under mean_delta_pp, while its decision/report readers expect a mean field. The unmodified analyzer first raised KeyError and then a formatting TypeError. Final analysis was completed using a one-run, in-memory JSON-serializable float adapter that supplied the expected mean interface. No frozen source, manifest, result artifact, or training run was changed; all generated summaries were recomputed and all 40 artifacts independently revalidated.

scientific_interpretation.condition_teacher: N3 differs numerically from N2 and N4, but its outer-train teacher accuracy is 0.5088, below shuffled N4 at 0.5160. Its mean ASD probability is 0.4885, entropy 0.69185, and mean across-subject probability SD 0.01694. Condition weighting changes teacher distributions but does not demonstrate diagnostic information beyond the shuffled control.
scientific_interpretation.non_imaging_student: N3 student train accuracy is 0.5023 and entropy 0.69255; real phenotype prototype CE drifts from 0.6936 to 0.6942. The non-imaging student remains near uniform and shows no useful training improvement.
scientific_interpretation.kl_supervision: N3 KL is nonzero and has phenotype embedding gradient norm 0.00181, while direct image embedding gradient is zero. KL rises from 0.00056 to 0.00374; CE/KL gradient cosine averages 0.0325 and the configured auxiliary output-gradient ratio is 4.91%. The pathway is active but does not produce an informative student or performance gain.
scientific_interpretation.candidate_assessment: MIXED; do not advance PCDPA-X2 as the first MICCAI 2027 innovation candidate. N3 AUC is effectively tied with historical M3 (+0.00021 pp), below N1 (-0.01589 pp), N2 (-0.04310 pp), N4 (-0.03769 pp), and historical D4 (-0.08997 pp). N3 also has lower ACC and SPE than M3 by 0.114 and 0.435 pp; no prespecified materiality margin was defined.
